about: The full-rig NAM pack: 15 TONE3000 A2 captures that include their cab (no cab block needed, for presets where Poly Capo leaves no DSP for one), User IR slots 121-128 and 44-50 (the pedal has 128 IR slots). Fills the starter library's amp-only gaps (Plexi, JTM45, Hiwatt, Mark, Friedman, Soldano, Orange, Dumble, Super Reverb/Bassman) plus Matchless, Bogner and Princeton. Picked 2026-11-09 by downloads and favorites; every page shows Amp + Cab.
